learning_outcomes.text: Analytical and Smith chart solutions of transmission line circuits
Relationship between transmission line and singular elements
Power and energy concepts for transmission lines
Equivalences between waveguides and transmission lines
Relationship of high frequency techniques with electromagnetic field and wave theory

syllabus_topics: Wave propagation and singular elements in transmission lines
Transmission line parameters, multiple transmission lines
Midterm exam, introduction to Smith Chart
Midterm exam solutions and transmission line applications
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course schedule. Midterm and final exam dates are held on the dates specified in the academic calendar by the decision of the University Senate.
